serverInfo.name: uploads-mcp
serverInfo.description: Host files on uploads.sh from an agent — put (including branch staging and PR attach), promote, list, delete, usage, galleries, whoami, and GitHub attachment comments.

authentication.description: Bearer token — either a per-workspace token (Authorization: Bearer up_<workspace>_…, via invitation + `uploads login`) or an OAuth 2.1 access token from the uploads-auth authorization server (browser consent flow; see /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource). See https://uploads.sh/auth.md
